baseline_models.focus_anchor: The noun for night is made the subject of the open-ended verb "covers," whose object is left unstated.
baseline_models.mechanism: Night is not merely a clock interval or a lack of daylight. It acts as a spreading layer over an unspecified field, so the verse foregrounds an operation of concealment whose reach remains deliberately open.

activation_trace.role: Night supplies the dark temporal field and functions as the agentive setting of the clause.
A veil laid over something supplies the concrete operation by which night changes the field.

changed_reading.before: An oath by night when darkness falls.
changed_reading.after: An oath by night precisely in its active phase of laying a veil over an unstated and therefore potentially total field.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The temporal particle marks the moment night performs يَغْشَىٰ, while both roots admit entry or approach rather than only static darkness.
baseline_models.mechanism: The clause can be felt kinetically: night enters and comes upon its destination like a visitor. Covering is then an arrival that progressively occupies a place, not an instantaneous switch from light to dark.

activation_trace.role: Entering or undertaking something by night gives the noun a threshold-crossing, processual force.
Coming upon or visiting supplies the motion by which the night reaches and occupies its unstated object.

changed_reading.before: Night is a static period already present.
changed_reading.after: Night is caught arriving upon the world, its covering understood as an advancing visitation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus verb can denote a covering that overtakes a person or the faculties, not only a cloth-like layer over an exterior.
baseline_models.mechanism: As the night covers, it can saturate the perceiver as well as the scene. The omitted object allows a double reach: the visible world is veiled and the observer's capacity to discriminate within it is reduced.

activation_trace.role: Night's intensified darkness supplies the environmental pressure that can exceed mere background dimness.
An enveloping event that takes people over expands the cover from local veil to total saturation.
The non-dominant mapped branch in which understanding is overcome makes perceptual loss a live secondary effect.

changed_reading.before: Night hides objects from an otherwise unchanged observer.
changed_reading.after: Night can overtake both objects and observer, temporarily covering the very faculty by which distinctions are made.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The branch inventory for يَغْشَىٰ includes bodily coming-over as an intimate euphemism, while night supplies enclosure and privacy.
baseline_models.mechanism: At the branch edge, covering can signify intimate joining rather than simple occlusion. The objectless verb leaves this as a latent bodily resonance: night gathers two sides into a shared enclosure.

activation_trace.role: Night supplies the enclosing darkness within which ordinary separations of visibility are suspended.
The intimate coming-over branch changes covering from hiding one thing to joining bodies within one enclosure.

changed_reading.before: Covering is exclusively an act of visual deprivation.
changed_reading.after: Covering also carries a contained, exploratory resonance of intimate joining under the privacy of night.

context_deltas.mechanism: The matched next oath turns night-covering into one half of a reversible surface process: night overlays and day opens, reveals, and can even be heard as polishing the same field into visibility.

activation_trace.role: The focus verb supplies the veiling operation that needs a counter-operation.
Daylight opening out supplies the temporal counterphase to the night veil.
Disclosure and appearance provide the inverse surface operation: what was covered becomes manifest.
Polishing sharpens disclosure into an active clearing of the surface rather than passive daylight.

structural_cues: 92:1 and 92:2 are matched oath clauses with the same وَـ...إِذَا... verbal frame.
The sequence places covering first and disclosure second without cancelling either phase.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies parallel clauses plus veil, opening, disclosure, and polishing images; I infer that they operate on a shared field in inverse directions, while a live alternative is simple contrast between two independent times.

changed_reading.before: Night is a one-way descent into darkness.
changed_reading.after: Night is the covering phase of a reversible cycle whose paired operation is active disclosure and surface clarification.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately following created pair gives the intimate branch of covering a generative rather than merely erotic direction. Night's enclosure can be carried as a joining of differentiated counterparts from which formed life becomes thinkable.

activation_trace.role: The intimate coming-over branch supplies the bodily joining that the next created pair can redirect toward generation.
Creative bringing-into-being supplies an emergent outcome for the otherwise private enclosure.
The male counterpart supplies one differentiated side of the created pairing.
The female counterpart completes the differentiated pair and keeps joining from collapsing into sameness.

structural_cues: The male-female creation oath follows directly after the matched night-day oaths.
Both sequences hold differentiated counterparts together rather than resolving one into the other.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an intimate branch for the focus verb and then creation of a sexed pair; I infer a joining-to-generation arrow, while the live alternative is that the two pairings are formally parallel but causally unrelated.

changed_reading.after: At an exploratory register, night's covering can also shelter differentiated joining and the hidden precondition of emergence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The cover spreads across one scene, yet the striving beneath it moves toward different objects and separates. Uniform darkness is therefore not uniformity of action; it is the common surface under which trajectories diverge.

activation_trace.role: A common veil supplies the apparently uniform surface over the scene.
Purposeful movement toward an object supplies distinct trajectories continuing beneath the cover.
Dispersion supplies the result: covered actors are not merged but move apart.

structural_cues: The first assertion after the three oaths declares the audience's striving divergent.
The singular covering event is followed by a plural possessive in سَعْيَكُمْ and a predicate of dispersion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one covering scene followed by purposeful yet scattered striving; I infer that concealment hides divergence rather than erasing it, while the alternative is that the oath and its proposition are evidentially linked without sharing a spatial mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Night homogenizes everything by making the whole scene dark.
changed_reading.after: Night supplies one visible cover over many hidden and increasingly divergent courses of action.

context_deltas.mechanism: The paired conduct sequences turn the covered field into a path-dependent medium. Giving, self-protection, and enacted verification align movement with opening and ease; withholding, denial, and crooked difficulty make the same hidden interval constrictive.

activation_trace.role: The veil supplies the common medium whose practical effect can differ by the actor's course.
Passing something into another's hand supplies outward flow rather than enclosure around the self.
Placing oneself within protection distinguishes a sheltering boundary from a blinding cover.
Making a promise real in action supplies alignment between an unseen commitment and a visible course.
Opening and ease after constriction supply the first trajectory's widening passage.
Withholding supplies the opposing motion of closing resources around the self.
A garment whose appearance misstates its condition makes denial function as a deceptive surface-cover.
Crookedness and obstruction supply the constricted trajectory produced on the opposing side.

structural_cues: The فَأَمَّا...وَأَمَّا pairing gives two responses to the earlier declaration of divergent striving.
The repeated causative نُيَسِّرُ holds facilitation constant while the destinations switch from ease to difficulty.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one veil, two opposed conduct chains, and mirrored facilitation formulas; I infer that conduct configures how the covered passage is traversed, while the alternative is that night only warrants the contrast and does not itself model the passage.

changed_reading.before: Night covers all actors in the same morally neutral way.
changed_reading.after: The shared cover becomes path-dependent: it can be traversed as opening protection or tightened into deceptive, crooked enclosure.

context_deltas.mechanism: Wealth and claimed self-sufficiency resemble a portable cover, but the fall tests that cover and finds it unable to suffice. The focus veil is thereby split into genuine shelter and mere possession-based camouflage.

activation_trace.role: The covering veil supplies the protective appearance against which material sufficiency is tested.
Sufficiency supplies the precise function that possessions fail to perform at the decisive moment.
Accumulated property supplies the attempted material layer of security.
A fall into ruin supplies the event that pierces the attempted cover and reveals its insufficiency.

structural_cues: The repeated إِذَا links the focus covering event with the later event of falling.
The rhetorical negation places wealth's failure exactly at the descent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a veil, failed sufficiency, accumulated wealth, and falling; I infer that wealth is being tested as a would-be cover, while the live alternative is that its failure is economic or eschatological without any covering analogy.

changed_reading.before: Any cover can be imagined as safety from exposure.
changed_reading.after: Night's veil raises a sharper distinction: concealment may look like safety, but an accumulated material cover cannot arrest a fall.

context_deltas.mechanism: Guidance supplies a subtle direction inside reduced visibility, while the first and the last bound the interval. Night's cover is thus neither directionless nor terminal: it is a traversable span held between origin and outcome.

activation_trace.role: The night nearest the day supplies a bounded temporal interval rather than endless darkness.
The veil supplies reduced visibility within the interval.
Gentle indication toward a road supplies orientation that does not depend on full visual exposure.
Deferral to a later time supplies the far boundary and preserves delayed outcome.
Return to an eventual issue links beginning with outcome and prevents the covered interval from becoming a dead end.

structural_cues: 92:12 asserts guidance, and 92:13 immediately spans the last and the first.
The focus night stands adjacent to day in the oath sequence, already implying a bounded phase.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealment, gentle road-direction, temporal deferral, and return to outcome; I infer a guided passage through a bounded interval, while the alternative is that the ownership claims are theological guarantees without a night-navigation mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Covering means loss of direction until visibility happens to return.
changed_reading.after: Night is a bounded hidden passage in which direction can be supplied subtly before the destination becomes visible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later warning introduces fire as a counterlight inside the covered field. Darkness is not identical with safety or the absence of manifestation; flame can tear through it as an exposing, painful disclosure.

activation_trace.role: The night veil supplies the dark field in which an opposed light can become starkly visible.
A warning that awakens caution gives the counterlight a revelatory and anticipatory function.
Kindled fire supplies literal illumination that is dangerous rather than reassuring.
Pure blazing flame gives the counterlight an active force capable of piercing the covered scene.
Encounter with heat turns visible flame into bodily contact rather than distant spectacle.
Hardship and suffering supply the experiential cost of that counter-disclosure.

structural_cues: The warning names fire and immediately intensifies it with a blazing verb.
The next clause moves from seeing or hearing warning to bodily encounter with the fire.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a night veil followed by warning, fire, blaze, and painful contact; I infer that flame acts as counter-disclosure within darkness, while the alternative is that the fire belongs only to a later judgment scene and does not modify the oath's night.

changed_reading.before: Night's cover is an undifferentiated absence of light.
changed_reading.after: Night becomes a contrast field where a hostile light can disclose consequence more violently than ordinary day.

context_deltas.mechanism: Denial and turning away convert environmental covering into chosen opacity. The unusual image of a garment that lies by its appearance makes rejection resemble wearing a misleading surface and then directing the face away from disclosure.

activation_trace.role: The literal veil supplies the external model that can be internalized as deliberate opacity.
A garment that misrepresents its own condition supplies a striking image of falsity as a worn surface.
Turning away supplies the agent's directional act that keeps the deceptive covering in place.

structural_cues: The two coordinated verbs in 92:16 join denial to bodily or directional withdrawal.
This agentive pair contrasts with the natural agency of night in 92:1.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a veil, a deceptive garment image, and turning away; I infer a transfer from natural covering to self-maintained opacity, while the alternative is that the garment branch is only a lexical outlier and denial has no covering mechanics.

changed_reading.before: The night veil is imposed equally from outside.
changed_reading.after: The natural veil becomes a model for a second, culpably chosen cover: a false surface maintained by turning away.

context_deltas.mechanism: Keeping danger to one side and placing oneself in protection revalue cover as shelter. Giving wealth then feeds purification and growth inside that protected margin, so enclosure need not blind or hoard; it can preserve a vulnerable process until it matures.

activation_trace.role: The focus veil supplies a neutral enclosing layer whose value can be revised from obscuring to sheltering.
Removal and separation to the side supply the protective spacing between person and danger.
Putting oneself within a guard supplies intentional protective enclosure.
Giving supplies outward transfer, preventing the sheltering boundary from becoming possessive closure.
Property supplies the material that crosses the boundary rather than being accumulated as a false cover.
Growth and increase supply the living process enabled within the protected margin.
Purification supplies the inner clearing that distinguishes shelter from concealment of corruption.

structural_cues: 92:17 keeps the giving subject away from the previously named fire, and 92:18 immediately identifies giving as his action.
The reflexive purification verb makes the outward transfer feed back into an inward process.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cover, protective separation, guardedness, giving, and purification-growth; I infer that a protective margin enables inner development, while the alternative is that avoidance and purification are rewards and motives without an enclosure mechanism.

changed_reading.before: To be covered is primarily to be deprived of sight.
changed_reading.after: Covering can also be a sheltering margin that holds danger aside while generosity permits inner clearing and growth.

context_deltas.mechanism: The negation of any nearby person's repayable favor, followed by seeking the highest Lord's face, turns night-covering into an ethics of action without a human audience. Public faces and reciprocal ledgers disappear under the veil, but direction does not: giving remains aimed beyond the covered social field.

activation_trace.role: Action undertaken by night supplies the practical setting of conduct performed outside ordinary visibility.
The veil removes the surrounding human field from view and makes motive harder to stage publicly.
Exhaustive negation removes every human counterparty from the motive structure.
Nearness and presence locate the absent claim in the giver's immediate social surroundings.
A received benefit supplies the social debt that the clause denies as the act's motive.
Reciprocal recompense supplies the ledger-like exchange explicitly excluded from the giving.
Active seeking restores directed motion after human repayment has been removed.
Direction and orientation supply the unseen aim that persists despite social invisibility.
Sovereignty relocates the act's reference point beyond nearby human ownership and obligation.
Height supplies the vertical direction beyond the socially covered horizontal field.

structural_cues: 92:19 first strips away a repayable human motive; the exception in 92:20 then supplies a single positive aim.
The movement from عِندَهُ to وَجْهِ رَبِّهِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ shifts orientation from nearby social presence to a higher referent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies night action, a veil, negated human reciprocity, and a higher sought direction; I infer that reduced public visibility tests and clarifies motive, while the live alternative is that night remains only oath imagery and the non-transactional ethic is independent of secrecy.

changed_reading.before: Night hides action by making its actors and objects unseen.
changed_reading.after: Night becomes a moral laboratory: human spectators and repayment ledgers are covered, yet an upward, non-transactional orientation remains active.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing promise of future satisfaction gives the arriving night a nonterminal horizon. What is covered now need not be absent or lost; satisfaction can remain deferred beyond the interval of invisibility.

activation_trace.role: A night defined in relation to the neighboring day supplies a temporary, bounded delay.
Coming upon or visiting makes the cover an arriving phase that can also pass onward.
Abundant or sought satisfaction supplies the positive state held beyond the present covered interval.

structural_cues: The future particle in 92:21 explicitly delays satisfaction.
The surah closes with an affective state rather than with the fire or the night.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a bounded night, an arriving cover, and promised future satisfaction; I infer that concealment functions as delay rather than cancellation, while the alternative is that the final future only marks reward and has no diurnal resonance.

changed_reading.before: What the night covers is simply unavailable.
changed_reading.after: Night is a temporary interval of withheld visibility across which a still-unseen satisfaction can remain operative.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because night conventionally darkens, whereas the cited focus branch covers a face with whiteness. It remains valid as an operation-level activation anchored in يَغْشَىٰ: covering changes the visible surface but does not lexically require blackness. Downstream prose should present it as a color-neutral analogy, not claim that the verse calls night white.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus verb's inventory includes whiteness spreading over an animal's whole face, separating the mechanics of covering from the color of the covering substance.

activation_trace.role: Whiteness covering an entire face supplies the paradox that the verb profiles surface replacement rather than darkness alone.
Polishing the surface supplies a neighboring contrast in which visibility also changes through treatment of an exterior layer.

changed_reading.before: يَغْشَىٰ is effectively synonymous with making dark.
changed_reading.after: The verb profiles total surface coverage; darkness is supplied by night, while the covering operation itself is color-neutral.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is branch-distant because it uses the non-dominant mapped inventory behind the context root for guidance. It remains anchored through the focus model of covered perception and is strengthened by the explicit later fall. Downstream prose should call it a somatic-spatial resonance, not redefine guidance as a precipice.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus cover can overtake understanding, making unseen terrain bodily consequential rather than merely visually absent.

activation_trace.role: Loss of awareness supplies the bodily vulnerability of moving when the field is covered.
Falling into ruin supplies the realized danger latent in covered movement.
The split-root image of a difficult descent supplies an unexpected terrain model against which subtle direction becomes urgent.

changed_reading.before: Night's cover is a flat visual curtain.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the cover makes the world into hidden steep terrain where impaired awareness, direction, and falling become one somatic problem.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the same context-root inventory spans formal prayer and contact with fire, while the source surface is in the fire clause. It remains anchored in the focus branch of undertaking action by night and exposes a latent bifurcation of what hidden time can host. Downstream prose must keep the prayer image explicitly branch-level and must not substitute it for the surface meaning of يَصْلَىٰ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Night's inventory includes undertaking or entering activity by night, allowing the covered interval to be tested as a morally unassigned container for opposed forms of orientation.

activation_trace.role: Doing or entering an affair by night supplies the hidden temporal container for the branch bifurcation.
Obligatory worship supplies one possible form of sustained orientation within a covered interval.
Encountering fire and its heat supplies the sharply opposed bodily orientation carried by the same root inventory.

changed_reading.before: Night determines the moral quality of what happens under its cover.
changed_reading.after: At the branch edge, night is a morally unassigned enclosure in which orientation can diverge radically, from disciplined worship to consuming heat.

strongest_changes: The paired day clause revises night from generic darkness into the covering half of a reversible cover-disclose process.
Divergent striving shows that one uniform veil can hide multiple opposed trajectories rather than homogenize them.
Protection, giving, and purification revalue covering as a sheltering margin capable of preserving growth.
The negation of human repayment and the seeking of a higher face turn night into a test of action whose direction persists after public visibility is removed.
summary.what_was_special: The unstated object of يَغْشَىٰ kept the cover productively open: it could spread over a surface, over perception, over social spectatorship, or around a protected process. The packet's split and branch-distant images also preserved coexisting readings in which cover is arrival, intimacy, deceptive clothing, shelter, or even a color-neutral surface operation.
remaining_uncertainties: The omitted object never decides whether night primarily covers the land, daylight, creatures, perception, action, or all of them.
The intimate and generative reading is visibly branch-anchored but remains exploratory because the focus grammar does not name bodies or an object.
The non-transactional secrecy model depends on carrying night-covering forward as a social-visibility mechanism; the context does not explicitly say the giving occurs at night.
The steep-terrain and prayer-fire readings depend on non-dominant or polysemous branch inventories and should remain contained rather than synthesized as primary meanings.
